# Client Review Preparer Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Wealth Management

## Overview

Use when preparing comprehensive client review packages for periodic advisory meetings including performance analysis, asset allocation review, financial plan progress, and discussion topic preparation.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [client-review-preparer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
client-review-preparer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@client-review-preparer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Generate consolidated performance reports across all accounts and custodians
- Produce asset allocation comparison: current vs target with drift analysis
- Summarize financial plan progress against stated goals and milestones
- Identify client-specific discussion topics: life events, market impact, tax planning

## Industry Standards Applied

- **GIPS**: Performance reporting standards for client review materials
- **SEC Form ADV Part 2A**: Advisory service and fee disclosure in client materials
- **Reg BI Care Obligation**: Documentation of care standard through periodic review
